subject: maths
question: Inlet pipes X and Y can fill a reservoir in 10 minutes and 15 minutes, respectively. A drainage pipe Z can empty the same reservoir in 30 minutes. If all three pipes are opened at once, how long will it take to fill the reservoir?
solution:
**Given:**

Pipe X fills the reservoir in 10 minutes

Pipe Y fills the reservoir in 15 minutes

Pipe Z empties the reservoir in 30 minutes

**Calculations:**

Let total capacity = LCM of 10, 15 and 30 = 30 units

Efficiency of X = 30 ÷ 10 = 3 units/min

Efficiency of Y = 30 ÷ 15 = 2 units/min

Efficiency of Z = 30 ÷ 30 = 1 unit/min (emptying, so negative)

⇒ Net efficiency = 3 + 2 − 1 = 4 units/min

⇒ Time taken = Total work ÷ Net efficiency

⇒ Time = 30/4 = 7.5 minutes

**∴ The reservoir will be completely filled in 7.5 minutes.**
